selection.split: Deterministic, related-query-family-disjoint assignment frozen before historical patches; held-out membership is recorded in tests/heldout/manifest.json and ships with the held-out set (bodies in Git LFS), outside the agent image.
selection.limitations: Schema availability is execution coverage, not eligibility. Missing schemas and unresolved BIGNUMERIC fixture mappings do not automatically exclude queries. Full source-to-target database equivalence is not claimed.
